system.description: You whisper a forbidden truth that rots the listener from the inside.

outcomes.success: Every creature within 20' that can hear you takes d8 damage and is Infected. A creature that speaks the secret aloud infects one listener.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and no one is Infected.
outcomes.ruin: The truth rots you as well: you are Infected. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
